pages.text: In this ritual a $(#ad03fc)Foliot$() is summoned $(bold)as an untamed spirit$().$(br2)The slaughter of a $(#ad03fc)Chicken$() and the offering of dyes are intended to entice the Foliot to take the shape of a parrot. As $(#ad03fc)Foliot$() are not among the smartest $()
spirits, they sometimes misunderstand the instructions ...$(br)
*This means, if a $(#ad03fc)Chicken$() is spawned, that's not a bug, just bad luck!*$(br)
